original_observation.concern: The source report says: “It acts on the Borel–Moore homology of the Lagrangian core of the framed quiver variety and gives an integrable highest-weight representation with highest weight w (Theorem 17 of the review...)”. The cited theorem concerns the direct sum of TOP homology groups H_d(V,W)(L(V,W)), not unqualified full Borel–Moore homology. See Nakajima, https://arxiv.org/pdf/1611.10000v1, §4.5, Theorem 17, printed p. 16; the preceding operator definitions also use those top groups. Full homology over v=0,1,2 has weight multiplicities 1,2,1 and total dimension 4, whereas the highest-weight-2 sl2 representation has multiplicities 1,1,1 and dimension 3. The source-reported highest-weight assertion needs the top-homology qualification.
